description: Find people who list a service on their profile, by what they offer and where: "web design" in "California". LinkedIn hides no one in this search, so it finds people that `linkedin/people` hides. Each result is a person, with their headline and place, 10 a page. Costs 7 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

name: search_linkedin_services
title: Find people who offer services on LinkedIn
